漫谈词元（新知）: A Casual Discussion on Token (New Knowledge)
【现象】人工智能浪潮席卷全球，人工智能大模型成为人们工作与生活的重要帮手: [Phenomenon] The wave of artificial intelligence is sweeping the globe, and AI large models have become important assistants in people's work and life
指数级增长的数字，见证我国人工智能产业的迅猛发展、应用规模的快速扩大: Exponential growth in figures witness the rapid development of China's artificial intelligence industry and swift expansion of application scale
简单来说，词元是人工智能大模型为了高效处理数据，把数据进行拆分后的“最小信息载体: Simply put, a token is the 'minimal information carrier' after artificial intelligence large models split data for efficient processing, which can be understood as 'characters/word fragments/symbols' and so on
如果说互联网时代信息传输的核心度量是“流量”，那么人工智能时代，这一关键指标正变: If the core metric for information transmission in the internet era is 'traffic flow,' then in the artificial intelligence era, this key indicator is transforming into tokens—every character input by users, every segment of text generated by the model, every image recognized, all consume tokens
词元消耗量爆发式增长，意味着越来越多人工智能应用落地，越来越多个人用户、企业客户: The explosive growth in token consumption means that more and more AI applications are landing in practice, and more individual users and enterprise customers are using intelligent tools to solve problems and improve efficiency
词元消耗增长与应用落地强绑定的特性，使其成为衡量人工智能产业景气度的重要晴雨表: The characteristic of token consumption growth being tightly bound to application landing makes it an important barometer for measuring the prosperity of the artificial intelligence industry
以长远视角观之，随着我国人工智能产业创新活力的不断释放，词元消耗量的增长不仅具有: From a long-term perspective, as the innovation vitality of China's artificial intelligence industry continues to be released, the growth in token consumption not only has short-term explosive force but also long-term sustainability
在政策层面，去年印发的《关于深入实施“人工智能+”行动的意见》强调，“推动人工智: At the policy level, the Opinion on Deeply Implementing the 'AI Plus' Initiative released last year emphasizes 'promoting the wide and deep integration of artificial intelligence with various industries and fields of the economy and society'
比如，人工智能为教育行业提供“长文本知识梳理”，为电商行业提供“多轮智能导购服务: For example, artificial intelligence provides education with 'long-text knowledge organization,' and provides e-commerce with 'multi-turn intelligent shopping guidance services'
在技术层面，加快“从0到1”的创新突破、“从1到N”的技术落地，更智能的人工智能: At the technical level, accelerating 'from zero to one' innovation breakthroughs and 'from one to many' technology landing, more intelligent AI agents are emerging at an accelerated pace, which not only expands development space but will also help reshape human production and living paradigms and promote revolutionary leaps in productivity
从此前单轮对话几十词元的“精打细算”，到如今企业级应用单轮亿万词元的“从容调度”: From the 'careful budgeting' of previous single-turn dialogues consuming dozens of tokens to today's 'ample scheduling' of enterprise-level applications consuming tens of millions of tokens in a single turn, thanks to cost reductions brought by technological progress, enterprises can now deploy AI at scale in more complex, more energy-intensive scenarios, continuously breaking through growth bottlenecks in token consumption
没有高质量的数据，词元就成了“无源之水”，模型训练和推理会因数据失真、残缺而输出: Without high-quality data, tokens become 'water without a source,' and model training and inference will output erroneous results due to data distortion and incompleteness, which is an important cause of AI hallucinations
